versions.subject: tentative rule to detect admin users remote login
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4624
    LogonType: 10
    LogonProcess:
      - C:\Windows\System32\winlogon.exe
      - C:\Windows\System32\lsass.exe
filter:
    NewAccountName: 'Admin-*'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: EventID=4624 LogonType=10 LogonProcess IN ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\winlogon.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe") NOT NewAccountName="Admin-*"
